comment: Each set points at a bundled GeoJSON file of clickable polygons. Features use properties: id, name, set, privacy (us|ca|eu), overpassAreaTag, overpassAreaValue, allowOverpass, lat, lng, bbox. To add a region set, add an object here and drop a GeoJSON file in data/geo/ — no code changes needed. privacy=eu hides emails (GDPR).
attribution: Region boundaries from Natural Earth (public domain). https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
